items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of Ausnahmegenehmigung
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie binnen eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 02.12.2025, posted by a general authority (Landratsamt, not Finanzamt) after 1 Jan 2025, so it is deemed delivered on the 4th calendar day after posting: 02.12.2025 + 4 days = 06.12.2025 (Saturday). For general authorities the delivery day itself is not moved even though it falls on a Saturday (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG / Art. 41 BayVwVfG). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 70 VwGO) then runs from that delivery day to the numerically same day of the following month: 06.12.2025 + 1 month = 06.01.2026. 06.01.2026 (Epiphany/Heilige Drei Könige) is a public holiday in Bavaria, so under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG the period end moves to the next working day, Wednesday 07.01.2026.
